name: buddy
description: The /buddy companion, revived as a mod: your original species, rarity, hat and stats, animated above the prompt, reacting to your work.

name.title: Name override
name.description: Leave empty to use the name your buddy hatched with (~/.claude.json).

personality.title: Personality override
personality.description: Leave empty to use the personality your buddy hatched with (~/.claude.json).

everyNTurns.title: Speak every N turns
everyNTurns.description: How many finished turns between quips (each quip is one Haiku call).

species.title: Species
species.description: Species of your original buddy: auto = the one your account rolled in the original /buddy; or pick any of the 18.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the buddy's lines and of its Haiku quips.

position.title: Position
position.description: Which side of the band the buddy sits on.

active.title: Active buddy
active.description: Name of the buddy to show; empty = your original one. /buddy use <name> overrides it. A buddy still in its egg falls back to the original.

sessionsPerHatch.title: Sessions per egg
sessionsPerHatch.description: Sessions together before /buddy add can hatch one more buddy.

buddiesFile.title: Buddies file
buddiesFile.description: JSON list of your extra buddies: { name, species?, personality? }; personality is a string or { tone, traits, quirks, backstory, speech, catchphrase, likes, dislikes }. /buddy add and rm write to it.
